name: Nkemdirim & Soh AcidVeil Sealed Rain Boot — High Shaft
description: Knee-high rain boots in glossy deep oxblood, constructed from Nkemdirim & Soh's proprietary AcidVeil polymer compound rated for Grade-4 acid rainfall — well above anything the open Shelf produces. Interior ankle cradle adapts to both natural and prosthetic feet via adjustable micro-tension lacing. The shaft has a subtle woven Yoruba-Scandinavian geometric band near the calf.
functionality: Grade-4 acid-rated waterproof boot with adaptive prosthetic-compatible ankle fit and full knee-height coverage.
what_it_says: This person spends real money on protection and won't compromise quality for price — even in something as mundane as boots.
story_hooks: A Shelf chem-worker was found wearing a single boot from this line — the other was never recovered. The boot showed acid damage from a source far worse than ambient Shelf rain.
Nkemdirim & Soh quietly recalled a production batch last season without announcement. This pair might be from that batch.
